description: This file implements encryption functions for different symmetric cipher algorithms within the TLS Crypto Provider Object, such as RC4, DES, 3DES, IDEA, RC2, and AES. It provides a unified interface 'TlsCpoEncrypt' that dispatches to specific algorithm implementations.

methods.description: Performs the specified symmetric encryption algorithm based on the cipher_algorithm parameter, dispatching to the appropriate encryption method.
